This small plot is rented, only a quarter hectare, so I must be careful what I spend on it. Since it is not my land, I will not invest heavily in chemical fertilizer, but I will put some manure from my animals because I have that at home for free. I will use the local seed I saved from last year — it is reliable and I know how it grows here in Oromia. My family and I will do most of the work ourselves; I may bring in a few neighbors only for weeding or harvest if the season gets busy.
